theme: Graphite GPU backend and new platform support
highlights_headline: The next SkiaSharp release adds the Graphite GPU backend, async pixel readback, and a new Vulkan Silk.NET package.
highlights_body: Graphite brings bindings for the modern Skia GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. A new `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` package wires Vulkan up end-to-end. Async `RequestReadPixels` lands on both `SKImage` and `SKSurface`. Memory leaks in `SKRegion.SpanIterator` and `SKPixmap.ExtractSubset` are fixed, and several performance optimizations reduce allocations further.

bullets.detail: Multiple upstream chrome/m151 fix merges are included, keeping the bundled engine current with Skia's stable branch.
New bindings expose Skia's next-generation Graphite GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, enabling access to the modern rendering pipeline.
A new backend-neutral async API lets callers read pixels from GPU-backed images and surfaces without stalling the GPU pipeline.
A dedicated package integrates SkiaSharp Graphite/Ganesh Vulkan rendering with the Silk.NET Vulkan bindings, and Vulkan integration tests now run on Android and Linux.

bullets.lead: FreeType font support on Nano Server
bullets.detail: FreeType is now used as the font backend on Windows Nano Server, enabling text rendering in container workloads where GDI is unavailable.
The `SKRegion` backing object was not rooted across the span iterator's lifetime and could be freed by the GC mid-iteration, causing memory corruption.
The pixel-source `SKPixmap` was not kept alive across derived pixmap operations, leading to use-after-free. The source is now rooted for the derived pixmap's lifetime.

bullets.lead: CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in `SKImage.Create` failure path fixed
bullets.detail: When the raster `SKImage.Create` overload failed after allocating the pixel buffer, the buffer was leaked. It is now freed on all failure paths.
The skip-registration reflection check in `HandleDictionary` is now cached on first call, eliminating repeated reflection overhead on every object registration.
The `SKData.SaveTo(Stream)` path now writes the native buffer directly to the stream, removing an intermediate managed `byte[]` copy.

bullets.lead: GetEncodedText null-terminated path avoids string allocation
bullets.detail: The null-terminated fast path in `GetEncodedText` no longer allocates an intermediate `string`.
`SKRuntimeEffectUniforms` now pre-allocates its uniform lookup map to the known count, avoiding rehash allocations during effect setup.
Test coverage now includes Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Windows Nano Server as first-class CI legs, catching platform-specific regressions earlier.
All `.sln` solution files have been migrated to the new `.slnx` format for improved tooling compatibility.

bullets.lead: MSVC environment initialized once per native build on Windows
bullets.detail: The Visual C++ environment setup is now performed once at the start of a native build pass rather than once per compilation unit, reducing build times on Windows.

bullets.lead: Binding generation made deterministic across platforms
bullets.detail: The SkiaSharp binding generator now produces identical output regardless of the host platform, preventing spurious diffs in CI.
